issues.summary: docs/harvester/install.md left stale 'schema v1.0' references in the validate-command section (lines ~144, 163, 337, 348), reading as current output and making the doc internally inconsistent.
issues.resolution: Updated all four: validate now described as checking against the embedded harvester-schema (v1.0 or v1.1) matching the manifest's declared schemaVersion; exit-0 text says 'its declared schema version — v1.0 or v1.1'; smoke-check example output bumped to 'schema v1.1' (examples/northwind-output.json declares schemaVersion 1.1); embedded-schema note now lists both v1.0 and v1.1 schema files. Also bumped the tag-format example on line 43 to v1.2.0 for consistency.

issues.summary: Session is release-prep only; the authoritative CI-built artifact, final SHA-256, tag push, and published release are pending. Maintainer approval must precede the TAG PUSH (not just the Publish click), because tag push creates the outward-facing draft + public tag.
issues.resolution: Process commitment honored: explicit maintainer go-ahead will be obtained BEFORE pushing the v1.2.0 tag, and again is implicit for the publish. The real bundle SHA-256 from the CI-built (authoritative) artifact replaces the <FILLED_AT_PUBLISH> placeholder before publishing. Not a code/doc defect.

issues.summary: Release-notes phrase 'The harvester schema is unchanged' is ambiguous for users upgrading from the last published release v1.0.0, for whom the published schema advances v1.0 -> v1.1.
issues.resolution: Reworded: schema is 'unchanged from the unpublished v1.1.0 draft'; for v1.0.0 upgraders the manifest schema advances v1.0 -> v1.1 (additive, backward-compatible; validate accepts both).
